column2: 演示：带有地标和游览的预制场景。地标作为新文件夹放入“我的地点”，列表下方的 ▶ 按钮播放游览。

column1: Description of the folder. It is kept in My Places and in KML.
column2: 文件夹的说明。保存在“我的地点”和 KML 中。

column1: Distance from the camera to the point of view. More - a wider view.
column2: 相机到视点的距离。越大 - 视野越广。

column1: Find what is typed in the line. A place - a flight to it, several found places - a list below.
column2: 查找输入行中的内容。一个地点 - 飞往该处，找到多个地点 - 下方列表。

column1: Full screen (F11) - the globe view for a show. Esc or F11 returns the window.
column2: 全屏 (F11) - 用于展示的地球视图。面板隐藏，导航控件、时间条和游览保留。Esc 或 F11 恢复窗口。

column1: Full screen. Exit - Esc or F11.
column2: 全屏。退出 - Esc 或 F11。

column1: Heights raise the surface and shade the slopes. The check turns the terrain on, a click on the name chooses the heights. Heights of the Earth - Mapzen Terrain Tiles. The vertical scale is in the view properties.
column2: 高程抬升地表并为坡面加阴影。复选框开启地形，单击名称选择高程。地球高程 - Mapzen Terrain Tiles。垂直夸张在视图属性中。

column1: Identify. A click on the globe shows the coordinates, the height or depth of the point and the placemarks there.
column2: 识别对象。单击地球显示该点的坐标、高度或深度以及地标。

column1: Imagery of the whole Earth, the example basemap. Its terms are set by Esri.
column2: 整个地球的影像，示例底图。其使用条件由 Esri 规定。

column1: Imagery or map on the surface. A click on the row chooses the basemap. Esri World Imagery is an example basemap, its terms are set by Esri.
column2: 地表的影像或地图。单击该行选择底图。Esri World Imagery 是示例底图，其使用条件由 Esri 规定。

column1: Latitude of the point the camera looks at.

Light of the terrain and the air by the position of the sun. The night side of the Earth is dark. The time of the sun is the end of the period of the open time slider, without it the computer clock. Without the check the light falls from the north-west, as on a relief map.
column2: 根据太阳位置的地形和空气光照。地球的夜半球是暗的。太阳时间为打开的时间条区间的终点，没有时间条时为计算机时钟。不勾选时光线从西北方照来，如同地势图。

column1: Longitude of the point the camera looks at.
Motorways yellow, main roads light yellow, the rest thin white. Over a city the roads cover the basemap with a dense mesh.
column2: 高速公路为黄色，主要道路为浅黄色，其余为细白色。在城市上空，道路以密集的网覆盖底图。

column1: Names of airports with a square icon, runways when zooming in. They are labelled from a height below 1000 km.
column2: 带方形图标的机场名称，放大时显示跑道。从低于 1000 公里的高度开始标注。

column1: Names of countries, regions, cities, towns and villages. Smaller places appear when zooming in.
column2: 国家、地区、城市、城镇和村庄的名称。放大时出现越来越小的地点。

column1: Names of seas, lakes and reservoirs, in light blue italics.
column2: 海洋、湖泊和水库的名称，浅蓝色斜体。

column1: Narrow rivers as blue lines. They appear from about 600 m per pixel.
column2: 狭窄河流显示为蓝线。约从每像素 600 米开始出现。

column1: Nature reserves, national parks and wildlife refuges, a green outline and a name. Names are seen below 3000 km, the outline together with motorways.
column2: 自然保护区、国家公园和野生动物保护区，绿色轮廓和名称。名称在 3000 公里以下可见，轮廓与高速公路一起出现。

column1: New placemark, path, polygon or circle in My Places.
column2: 在“我的地点”中新建地标、路径、多边形或圆。

column1: Only one placemark or folder of this folder is seen on the globe. The check of one row clears the checks of the others.
column2: 地球上只显示此文件夹中的一个地标或文件夹。勾选一行会取消其他行的勾选。

column1: Opacity of the selected placemarks, paths, polygons, pictures and folder contents. To the left - more transparent. The value is kept in My Places and in KML.
column2: 所选地标、路径、多边形、图片和文件夹内容的不透明度。向左 - 更透明。该值保存在“我的地点”和 KML 中。

column1: Parallels and meridians with degree labels, the equator, the tropics and the polar circles. The step of the grid changes with the camera height.
column2: 带度数标注的纬线和经线、赤道、回归线和极圈。网格间距随相机高度变化。

column1: Peaks and volcanoes with their height in metres, a triangle icon. They are labelled from a height below 400 km.
column2: 山峰和火山，以米为单位标注高度，三角形图标。从低于 400 公里的高度开始标注。

column1: Place, coordinates or action. A place name or coordinates, for example Perm or 58.0105, 56.2294, give a flight. A layer or a window, for example «ruler» or «grid», is found by its name and turned on from the hint. Ctrl+K from anywhere in the window puts the cursor into this line.
column2: 地点、坐标或操作。地名或坐标，例如 Perm 或 58.0105, 56.2294，将飞往该处。图层或窗口，例如“标尺”或“网格”，按名称查找并从提示中开启。在窗口任意位置按 Ctrl+K 可将光标置于此行。

column1: Plates with numbers of motorways and main roads. They are labelled from a height below 1000 km.
column2: 高速公路和主要道路的编号牌。从低于 1000 公里的高度开始标注。

column1: Record a tour. Camera motion by mouse, keys or flights becomes a tour in My Places, a second click stops the recording.
column2: 录制游览。用鼠标、按键或飞行移动相机的过程会成为“我的地点”中的游览，再次单击停止录制。

column1: Return the view the folder had when the window opened.
column2: 恢复打开窗口时文件夹的视图。

column1: Roads, their numbers, railways and airports.
column2: 道路、道路编号、铁路和机场。

column1: Ruler. Length, perimeter and area on the ellipsoid, the measurement can be saved to My Places.
column2: 标尺。椭球面上的长度、周长和面积，测量结果可保存到“我的地点”。

column1: Save view. The point of view becomes a placemark in My Places, flying to it returns the height, heading and tilt.
column2: 保存视图。视点成为“我的地点”中的地标，飞往该地标会恢复高度、方向和倾斜。

column1: Scene - the camera and the selected folder of My Places with its tour. It is saved to a file and opens on another computer.
column2: 场景 - 相机以及“我的地点”中所选文件夹及其游览。保存为文件，可在另一台计算机上打开。

column1: Shores of lakes, reservoirs and wide rivers outlined in blue. Reservoirs are cut into pieces in the data, and the outline runs along the cuts too.
column2: 湖泊、水库和宽阔河流的岸线以蓝色勾勒。数据中的水库被切成若干块，轮廓也沿切口延伸。

column1: Show contents as a group of radio buttons
column2: 将内容显示为一组单选按钮
为文件夹采用当前视图

column1: Snapshot of the view to a PNG file.
column2: 将视图快照保存为 PNG 文件。

column1: Take the view of the globe now: the point of view, distance, heading and tilt.
column2: 采用地球的当前视图：视点、距离、方向和倾斜。

column1: The blue glow of the air around the planet, the sky over the horizon and the haze over the distant surface. Without the check the background of the view is black space, the surface is seen without haze.
column2: 地球周围空气的蓝色辉光、地平线上方的天空以及远处地表上的薄雾。不勾选时视图背景为黑色太空，地表无薄雾。

column1: The check shows a layer on the globe. A row - its description. Layers are turned on together.
column2: 复选框在地球上显示图层。行 - 图层说明。图层可同时开启。

column1: The OpenFreeMap vector base and the coordinate grid.
column2: OpenFreeMap 矢量底图和坐标网格。

column1: The placemark is seen only while the eye is closer than this distance, as Region in KML. For a folder - all its placemarks. 0 - always seen.
column2: 仅当视点比此距离更近时地标才可见，如同 KML 中的 Region。对于文件夹 - 其所有地标。0 - 始终可见。

column1: The sun and the night side, the atmosphere.
The view is copied to the clipboard.
Tilt of the camera. 0 - looking straight down, more - towards the horizon.
column2: 相机的倾斜。0 - 垂直向下看，越大 - 越接近地平线。

column1: Time slider. While it is open, data outside its period is hidden. The closed slider shows all placemarks.
column2: 时间条。打开时，其区间以外的数据被隐藏。关闭的时间条显示所有地标。

column1: Tour over the checked places of the folder
column2: 游览文件夹中已勾选的地标

column1: Tour: select the My Places folder or a path in it
column2: 游览：请选择“我的地点”中的文件夹或其中的路径

column1: View properties: relief scale, language of labels, appearance.
column2: 视图属性：底图和数据来源、垂直夸张、标注语言、坐标格式、外观。

column1: Where the camera looks from when it flies to the folder. The view is set by numbers or by a snapshot of the current view. Without its own view the flight frames all placemarks of the folder.
column2: 相机飞往文件夹时从何处观看。视图通过数字或采用当前视图来设置。没有自己的视图时，飞行会将文件夹中的所有地标纳入画面。

column1: Where the camera looks. 0 - north at the top of the frame.
column2: 相机的朝向。0 - 北方在画面上方。

column1: Without the check the folder does not expand in the list, its placemarks are shown and hidden by the check of the folder.
column2: 不勾选时文件夹在列表中不展开，其地标由文件夹本身的复选框显示和隐藏。

column1: How many seconds the camera stands at each stop. A new pause acts from a jump by the buttons or from a new start of the tour.
column2: 相机在每个停靠点停留的秒数。新的停留时间从按钮跳转或重新开始游览时生效。

column1: How much of the tour has passed. The slider rewinds the tour. The camera stands at this point at once, the tour goes on from it.
column2: 游览已进行的部分。滑块可快进或倒退游览。相机立即移到该点，游览从该点继续。

column1: Stop captions on the frame. At a stop the name and the description of the placemark stand large at the bottom of the frame, in flight there is no caption.
column2: 画面上的停靠点说明。在停靠点，地标的名称和说明以大字显示在画面底部，飞行途中没有说明。

column1: Tour in a loop. After the last stop the tour starts from the first. Pause or the cross stops it.
column2: 循环游览。最后一个停靠点之后，游览从第一个重新开始。暂停或叉号可停止游览。

column1: The geological and lithological maps, earthquakes, plate boundaries and faults, mineral deposits and mining areas, the Earth cutaway and palaeogeography.
column2: 地质图和岩性图、地震、板块边界和断层、矿床和采矿区、地球剖面和古地理。

column1: Properties of the topsoil 0-5 cm from SoilGrids - clay, sand, organic carbon and pH, a 250 m grid.
column2: SoilGrids 表层土壤 0-5 cm 的属性 - 黏土、沙、有机碳和 pH，250 m 格网。

column1: Transparent maps over the base map - sea marks, hiking and cycling routes. Several can be on at once.
column2: 叠加在底图上的透明地图 - 航标、徒步路线和骑行路线。可同时开启多个。

column1: OpenSeaMap navigation marks - buoys, lighthouses, leading lines, fairways and anchorages. The marks are seen close up, from map scale about 1:500 000. The map does not replace a nautical chart.
column2: OpenSeaMap 航标 - 浮标、灯塔、导标、航道和锚地。航标在近处可见，从约 1:500 000 的地图比例尺开始显示。该地图不能代替海图。

column1: Waymarked hiking routes from OpenStreetMap by Waymarked Trails - international, national, regional and local trails in the colour of their level.
column2: Waymarked Trails 提供的 OpenStreetMap 标记徒步路线 - 国际、国家、区域和地方步道，以其等级颜色显示。

column1: Waymarked cycling routes from OpenStreetMap by Waymarked Trails - from international cycle routes to local ones.
column2: Waymarked Trails 提供的 OpenStreetMap 标记骑行路线 - 从国际骑行路线到地方路线。

column1: The GLiM lithological map of the world - surface rocks in 16 classes: unconsolidated sediments, sedimentary, volcanic, plutonic and metamorphic rocks, ice. It is compiled from 92 regional maps at a scale of about 1:3 750 000. A click in Identify features mode shows the rock class. The globe shows one such map - lithological, geological, soil, water or a geophysical value map.
column2: GLiM 世界岩性图 - 地表岩石分为 16 类：松散沉积物、沉积岩、火山岩、深成岩和变质岩、冰。该图由 92 幅区域图汇编而成，比例尺约为 1:3 750 000。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示岩石类别。地球上只显示一幅此类地图 - 岩性图、地质图、土壤图、水体图或地球物理数值图。

column1: The ESA WorldCover land cover map for 2021 from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 images with a 10 m pixel - forest, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up, bare land, snow and ice, water, wetland, mangroves, moss and lichen. A click in Identify features mode shows the class.
column2: 基于 Sentinel-1 和 Sentinel-2 影像的 2021 年 ESA WorldCover 土地覆盖图，像元 10 m - 森林、灌丛、草地、耕地、建成区、裸地、冰雪、水体、湿地、红树林、苔藓和地衣。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示类别。

column1: What happened to water from 1984 to 2021 in Landsat images - permanent and seasonal water, new and lost, transitions between them, JRC Global Surface Water. New reservoirs, shrunken lakes and migrating channels are visible. A click in Identify features mode shows the class.
column2: Landsat 影像中 1984 年至 2021 年水体的变化 - 永久水体和季节性水体、新增和消失的水体、它们之间的转换，JRC Global Surface Water。可见新水库、萎缩的湖泊和迁移的河道。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示类别。

column1: The share of clay particles in the soil layer 0-5 cm from ISRIC SoilGrids - a model built on 240 thousand soil profiles, a 250 m grid. A click in Identify features mode asks SoilGrids for the value.
column2: ISRIC SoilGrids 土壤层 0-5 cm 中黏粒的比例 - 基于 24 万个土壤剖面的模型，250 m 格网。在“识别对象”模式下单击会向 SoilGrids 查询数值。

column1: The share of sand particles in the soil layer 0-5 cm from ISRIC SoilGrids, a 250 m grid. A click in Identify features mode asks SoilGrids for the value.
column2: ISRIC SoilGrids 土壤层 0-5 cm 中砂粒的比例，250 m 格网。在“识别对象”模式下单击会向 SoilGrids 查询数值。

column1: Organic carbon content of the soil layer 0-5 cm from ISRIC SoilGrids, g/kg, a 250 m grid. The highest values are in the peatlands of the tundra and taiga. A click in Identify features mode asks SoilGrids for the value.
column2: ISRIC SoilGrids 土壤层 0-5 cm 的有机碳含量，g/kg，250 m 格网。最高值位于苔原和泰加林的泥炭地。在“识别对象”模式下单击会向 SoilGrids 查询数值。

column1: Soil pH in water, layer 0-5 cm, from ISRIC SoilGrids, a 250 m grid. Yellow soils are acid, green neutral, turquoise alkaline. A click in Identify features mode asks SoilGrids for the value.
column2: ISRIC SoilGrids 水浸提土壤 pH，土层 0-5 cm，250 m 格网。黄色为酸性土壤，绿色为中性，青绿色为碱性。在“识别对象”模式下单击会向 SoilGrids 查询数值。

column1: Age of the oceanic crust after the grid of Seton et al. 2020, 0.1° spacing. Young floor at mid-ocean ridges is red, old floor at ocean margins is blue and purple. Land and continental crust are not coloured. The globe shows one value map at a time - ocean floor age, magnetic anomalies, gravity or heat flow. A click in the Identify features mode shows the age in Ma.
column2: 根据 Seton 等 2020 年格网的洋壳年龄，间距 0.1°。洋中脊处的年轻洋底为红色，大洋边缘的古老洋底为蓝色和紫色。陆地和大陆地壳不着色。地球上一次只显示一幅数值图 - 洋底年龄、磁异常、重力或热流。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示以 Ma 为单位的年龄。

column1: Free-air gravity anomaly after the XGM2019e model to degree 719, about 28 km spacing. Red marks gravity above normal, blue marks gravity below normal. Deep-sea trenches show lows down to -300 mGal, volcanic islands and mountains show highs. A click in the Identify features mode shows the anomaly in mGal.
column2: 根据 XGM2019e 模型至 719 阶的自由空气重力异常，间距约 28 km。红色表示重力高于正常值，蓝色表示低于正常值。深海海沟显示低至 -300 mGal 的低值，火山岛和山脉显示高值。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示以 mGal 为单位的异常。

column1: Gravity anomaly minus the attraction of the relief - the Bouguer correction after the ETOPO 2022 relief with a rock density of 2670 kg/m³, water and ice with their own densities, and the terrain correction for the surrounding relief within 167 km. The anomaly shows the density of the interior without the effect of mountains and ocean depths. Under mountains it is negative, which is thick light crust, over the ocean it is positive. A click in the Identify features mode shows the anomaly in mGal.
column2: 减去地形引力的重力异常 - 基于 ETOPO 2022 地形的布格改正，岩石密度 2670 kg/m³，水和冰按各自密度计算，并对半径 167 km 内的周围地形进行地形改正。该异常显示不受山脉和海洋深度影响的地下密度。山脉下方为负值，表示厚而轻的地壳，海洋上方为正值。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示以 mGal 为单位的异常。

column1: Heat flow from the interior through the Earth's surface on a 0.5° grid built from 91 thousand measurements of the IHFC 2024 database. Blue marks cold old shields, red marks rifts, ridges and volcanic areas. Far from measurements the grid is smoothed. A click in the Identify features mode shows the flow in mW/m².
column2: 基于 IHFC 2024 数据库 9.1 万个测量值构建的 0.5° 格网，表示地球内部经地表散出的热流。蓝色表示寒冷古老的地盾，红色表示裂谷、洋脊和火山区。远离测点处格网经过平滑。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示以 mW/m² 为单位的热流。

column1: Anomalies of the Earth magnetic field after the NOAA NCEI EMAG2v3 grid - the departure of the field from the normal one at 4 km above the ellipsoid, a step of about 4 km. Red means a stronger field, blue a weaker one. The anomalies reveal the crust - ridges and stripes of the ocean floor, ancient shields, ore districts. Empty places have no survey. A click in the Identify features mode shows the value in nT.
column2: 根据 NOAA NCEI EMAG2v3 格网的地磁场异常 - 椭球面以上 4 km 处磁场相对正常磁场的偏差，间距约 4 km。红色表示磁场较强，蓝色表示较弱。异常揭示地壳结构 - 洋底的洋脊和条带、古老地盾、矿区。空白处没有测量。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示以 nT 为单位的数值。

column1: Precipitation, soil moisture, snow, ice, water vapor, chlorophyll, salinity and floods from NASA data, currents from NOAA data.
column2: NASA 数据中的降水、土壤湿度、雪、冰、水汽、叶绿素、盐度和洪水，NOAA 数据中的洋流。

column1: Vegetation, dust, night lights and land cover types from NASA data.
column2: NASA 数据中的植被、沙尘、夜间灯光和土地覆盖类型。

column1: Fire spots, smoke, aerosol and carbon monoxide of fires and industry from NASA data.
column2: NASA 数据中的火点、烟雾、气溶胶以及火灾和工业排放的一氧化碳。

column1: Nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide, methane, carbon dioxide and ozone from NASA data.
column2: NASA 数据中的二氧化氮、二氧化硫、甲烷、二氧化碳和臭氧。

column1: Absorbing aerosol - smoke of fires and dust - from OMPS per day, since 2012.
column2: 吸收性气溶胶 - 火灾烟雾和沙尘 - OMPS 逐日数据，自 2012 年起。

column1: How much the air dims light because of smoke, dust and smog, MODIS per day, since 2017.
column2: 空气因烟雾、沙尘和雾霾对光的削弱程度，MODIS 逐日数据，自 2017 年起。

column1: Carbon monoxide mixing ratio at about 5 km from AIRS per day, since 2002. Fire plumes are seen over thousands of kilometres.
column2: AIRS 约 5 km 高度的一氧化碳混合比，逐日，自 2002 年起。火灾烟羽可延伸数千公里。

column1: Surface carbon monoxide emission from the MERRA-2 reanalysis per month, since 1980. The series lags by several months.
column2: MERRA-2 再分析的地表一氧化碳排放，逐月，自 1980 年起。该序列滞后数月。

column1: IMERG precipitation rate per day, since 2000.
column2: IMERG 降水强度，逐日，自 2000 年起。

column1: Moisture of the top centimetres of soil from SMAP per day, since 2015. The series has missing days.
column2: SMAP 土壤表层数厘米的湿度，逐日，自 2015 年起。序列中有缺失的日期。

column1: Snow from MODIS Terra imagery per day, since 2000. There are gaps under clouds and in the polar night, seas and lakes are not coloured.
column2: MODIS Terra 影像中的积雪，逐日，自 2000 年起。云下和极夜期间有空缺，海洋和湖泊不着色。

column1: Snow and lake ice from MODIS Terra imagery, an 8-day summary, since 2000. There are fewer gaps under clouds than in the daily layer.
column2: MODIS Terra 影像中的积雪和湖冰，8 天合成，自 2000 年起。云下的空缺比逐日图层少。

column1: Snow amount in kilograms per square metre from the SMAP Level 4 model per day, since 2015, a cell of about 9 km. It is a model calculation from satellite data, clouds leave no gaps.
column2: SMAP Level 4 模型中每平方米的积雪量（千克），逐日，自 2015 年起，单元约 9 km。这是基于卫星数据的模型计算，云不会造成空缺。

column1: Sea ice concentration from GHRSST MUR per day, since 2002.
column2: GHRSST MUR 海冰密集度，逐日，自 2002 年起。

column1: Water vapour in the atmospheric column from MODIS Terra per day, since 2000.
column2: MODIS Terra 大气柱中的水汽，逐日，自 2000 年起。

column1: Algae chlorophyll in the surface layer of the sea from PACE per day, since 2024.
column2: PACE 海洋表层藻类叶绿素，逐日，自 2024 年起。

column1: Sea surface salinity from SMAP, an 8-day running mean, since 2015.
column2: SMAP 海表盐度，8 天滑动平均，自 2015 年起。

column1: Water beyond its usual banks from MODIS over 3 days, since 2021.
column2: MODIS 3 天内超出正常河岸的水体，自 2021 年起。

column1: Tropospheric nitrogen dioxide from TROPOMI per day, since 2018. Cities, roads and power plants are seen.
column2: TROPOMI 对流层二氧化氮，逐日，自 2018 年起。可见城市、道路和发电厂。

column1: Near-surface sulphur dioxide from OMPS per day, since 2012. Volcanoes and plants are seen.
column2: OMPS 近地表二氧化硫，逐日，自 2012 年起。可见火山和工厂。

column1: Methane mixing ratio at about 7 km from AIRS per month, since 2002.
column2: AIRS 约 7 km 高度的甲烷混合比，逐月，自 2002 年起。

column1: Column-average carbon dioxide from OCO-2, orbit swaths per day, since 2014. The series lags by several months.
column2: OCO-2 二氧化碳柱平均浓度，逐日轨道条带，自 2014 年起。该序列滞后数月。

column1: Total column ozone from OMI per day, since 2004. The ozone hole over Antarctica is seen.
column2: OMI 臭氧总量，逐日，自 2004 年起。可见南极上空的臭氧洞。

column1: NDVI vegetation index from MODIS Terra over 16 days, since 2000. The series lags by a month.
column2: MODIS Terra 植被指数 NDVI，16 天合成，自 2000 年起。该序列滞后一个月。

column1: Dust in the atmosphere from AIRS per day, since 2002.
column2: AIRS 大气中的沙尘，逐日，自 2002 年起。

column1: VIIRS night image per day, since 2021. City lights, fires, gas flares and auroras are seen.
column2: VIIRS 夜间影像，逐日，自 2021 年起。可见城市灯光、火灾、天然气火炬和极光。

column1: Click - the class at the point

Earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 and above over the last 30 days from the USGS feed. A circle marks the epicentre on the surface. The focus is seen at its depth in the removed sector of the Earth cutaway row. The colour shows the focus depth, the size shows the magnitude. The feed is loaded when the row is switched on.
column2: 根据 USGS 数据，过去 30 天内震级 4.5 及以上的地震。圆圈标出地表的震中。震源在其深度处显示于“地球剖面”行的移除扇区中。颜色表示震源深度，大小表示震级。打开该行时加载数据。

column1: About 1200 volcanoes that erupted in the last 12 thousand years after the Global Volcanism Program list of the Smithsonian Institution. The colour is the time of the last eruption, the size is the volcano height. A click on a dot shows the volcano type, the year of the last eruption, the tectonic setting and the volcano page on the GVP site. The first switch-on downloads about 2 MB.
column2: 根据 Smithsonian Institution 的 Global Volcanism Program 名录，过去 1.2 万年内喷发过的约 1200 座火山。颜色表示最近一次喷发的时间，大小表示火山高度。单击点显示火山类型、最近一次喷发年份、构造环境以及 GVP 网站上的火山页面。首次打开下载约 2 MB。

column1: Fire spots of the last 24 hours from VIIRS images of the NOAA-20 satellite, the NASA FIRMS feed. The color and size of a dot show the radiative power.
column2: 根据 NOAA-20 卫星的 VIIRS 影像，过去 24 小时的火点，NASA FIRMS 数据。点的颜色和大小表示辐射功率。

column1: Lines of equal terrain height, as on a topographic map. The interval follows the view scale - hundreds of metres from afar, 5-10 m close up, every fifth contour is thicker and labelled with its height. Below sea level they are blue isobaths. They are built from the globe heights and from an own terrain raster of the project.
column2: 地形高度相等的线，如同地形图上一样。等高距随视图比例尺选择 - 远看为数百米，近看为 5-10 米。每第五条等高线加粗并标注高程。海平面以下为蓝色等深线。根据地球高程和项目自有的地形栅格生成。
每 {step} 米，每 {index} 米加粗

column1: The raster "{name}" goes into the globe terrain as the bed of the water body, water is drawn above it at the water body level. The default level is the terrain height at the edge of the raster, for a lake it is usually the water surface.
column2: 栅格“{name}”作为水体底部进入地球地形，其上按水体水位绘制水面。默认水位为栅格边缘处的地形高度，对湖泊而言通常就是水面。

column1: The depth below the water surface, with a plus or minus sign. The bed elevation is the water level minus the depth.
column2: 水面以下的深度，带正号或负号。水底高程等于水位减去水深。

column1: The bed height above sea level, like the terrain. The water level is needed only for the water surface.
column2: 水底相对海平面的高度，与地形相同。水位仅用于水面。

column1: The height of the water surface above sea level. The water is drawn at this height over all points where the bed is lower.
column2: 水面相对海平面的高度。在水底低于此高度的所有点上方，按此高度绘制水面。

column1: The raster is no longer the globe terrain, no water is drawn over it.
column2: 栅格不再作为地球地形，其上不绘制水面。

column1: Surface slope from the terrain heights, in classes from flat to steeper than 35°. The scale is in the bottom left corner of the view. Available on the Earth, Mars and the Moon.
column2: 根据地形高程计算的地表坡度，分级从平坦到大于 35°。图例位于视图左下角。适用于地球、火星和月球。

column1: Which way a slope faces - the colour of the compass direction, flat ground is grey. It replaces the slope when switched on.
column2: 坡面朝向 - 以方位颜色表示，平地为灰色。开启后替代坡度。

column1: Colouring of the surface by slope or by the direction a slope faces, one of the two is on. Terrain contours lie over them.
column2: 按坡度或坡面朝向为地表着色，二者只开启其一。地形等高线位于其上方。

column1: The Macrostrat geological map of the world compiled from maps of different scales. The colour shows the age of the rocks. In Russia and Europe the most detailed map is 1:5 000 000, in the USA the maps are much more detailed. A click in the Identify features mode shows the unit, the lithology, the age in Ma and the source map. The globe shows one such map - the geological map or a geophysical value map.
column2: Macrostrat 世界地质图，由不同比例尺的地图汇编而成。颜色表示岩石年龄。在俄罗斯和欧洲，最详细的地图为 1:5 000 000，美国的地图则详细得多。在“识别对象”模式下单击可显示地质单元、岩性、以 Ma 为单位的年龄和来源地图。地球上只显示一幅此类地图 - 地质图或地球物理数值图。

column1: The map is empty at the point
Power plants of the world, power lines, substations, pipelines and submarine cables.
column2: 世界发电厂、输电线路、变电站、管道和海底电缆。

column1: A click on a line - details
column2: 单击线条 - 详细信息

column1: About 13.7 thousand active faults of the world from the GEM Global Active Faults database compiled from regional catalogues. The colour shows the kind of slip. It is a normal fault, a reverse fault or thrust, a strike-slip fault, a spreading ridge and a fold. A click on a line shows the name, the kind of slip, the slip rate in mm/yr, the dip and the source catalogue. The first switch-on downloads about 11 MB.
column2: 根据由区域目录汇编的 GEM Global Active Faults 数据库，世界约 1.37 万条活动断层。颜色表示位移类型。类型为正断层、逆断层或逆冲断层、走滑断层、扩张脊和褶皱。单击线条可显示名称、位移类型、以毫米/年为单位的速率、倾角和来源目录。首次打开下载约 11 MB。

column1: Lithospheric plate boundaries after the PB2002 model. Red - plates moving apart at ridges and rifts, green - plates sliding along transform faults, blue - plates converging in subduction and collision zones. Plate names show as labels. The Features window shows the boundary type and the plate speed.
column2: 根据 PB2002 模型的岩石圈板块边界。红色 - 洋脊和裂谷处的板块分离，绿色 - 沿转换断层的错动，蓝色 - 俯冲带和碰撞带的汇聚。板块名称以标注显示。边界类型和板块速度显示在“对象”窗口中。

column1: Submarine communication lines (turquoise) and power cables (purple) from OpenStreetMap, visible from any altitude. OSM holds part of the world's cables, most of them in the Atlantic and near Europe. A click on a line shows the name, owner and a link to the OpenStreetMap object.
column2: 来自 OpenStreetMap 的海底通信线路（青绿色）和电力电缆（紫色），在任何高度均可见。OSM 收录了世界部分电缆，大多位于大西洋和欧洲附近。单击线条可显示名称、所有者和 OpenStreetMap 对象的链接。

column1: About 35 thousand power plants of the world from the WRI Global Power Plant Database, data as of 2021. Colour is the fuel, size is the capacity. A click on a dot shows the name, capacity, commissioning year and owner. Some plants are placed wrongly in the database. The first use downloads about 4 MB.
column2: 来自 WRI Global Power Plant Database 的世界约 3.5 万座发电厂，数据截至 2021 年。颜色表示燃料，大小表示装机容量。单击点可显示名称、装机容量、投运年份和所有者。部分电厂在数据库中的位置有误。首次打开下载约 4 MB。

column1: Mineral deposits, mines and occurrences of USGS - the MRDS database, about 300 thousand points, most of them in the USA, 3 thousand major deposits of the world and 6.5 thousand mines and plants of the world with the operator and capacity. The colour is the commodity group, a large point is a major deposit, mine or plant. A click on a point shows the name, commodities, type and a link to the USGS record. The first switch-on downloads about 25 MB.
column2: USGS 的矿床、矿山和矿点 - MRDS 数据库，约 30 万个点，大多位于美国，另有世界 3000 个大型矿床和 6500 个附有运营方和产能的世界矿山与工厂。颜色表示矿种组，大点表示大型矿床、矿山或工厂。单击点可显示名称、矿种、类型和 USGS 记录的链接。首次打开下载约 25 MB。

column1: Major mineral deposits of the world, USGS OFR 2005-1294
World mines and plants, USGS mineral operations
column2: 世界矿山和工厂，USGS mineral operations

column1: The north and south magnetic poles - the points where a compass needle stands vertical - for the year of the time slider and their path since 1590 after NOAA NCEI. The slider opens by itself, its handle moves the poles over the years. A click on the globe in the Identify features mode shows the declination, inclination and field intensity at the point for the same year after the gufm1 and IGRF-14 models, from 1590 to 2030.
column2: 北磁极和南磁极 - 罗盘指针竖直的点 - 按时间条所示年份显示，并根据 NOAA NCEI 数据显示其自 1590 年以来的移动路径。时间条自动打开，拖动滑块使磁极随年份移动。在“识别对象”模式下单击地球，可根据 gufm1 和 IGRF-14 模型显示同一年该点的磁偏角、磁倾角和总场强，范围为 1590 年至 2030 年。

column1: Lines of equal magnetic declination, the angle between the compass needle and the north, every 10° for the year of the time scale after the IGRF-14 model from 1900 and the gufm1 model from 1590, gufm1 is downloaded on first display. Red lines are east declination, blue lines west, the green line zero. The lines meet at the magnetic poles.
column2: 磁偏角相等的线，磁偏角即罗盘指针与北方向之间的夹角，按时间条所示年份每隔 10° 绘制。1900 年起采用 IGRF-14 模型，1590 年起采用 gufm1 模型，gufm1 在首次显示时下载。红线为东偏，蓝线为西偏，绿线为零。各线在磁极处汇聚。

column1: Arrows of lithospheric plate motion after the NNR-MORVEL56 model, the speed relative to the mean motion of all plates. The arrow grows with the speed, the number at its start is mm/yr. The Pacific plate moves north-west at about 70 mm/yr, the Eurasian plate at about 25. The Features window shows the plate, speed and direction at the point.
column2: 根据 NNR-MORVEL56 模型的岩石圈板块运动箭头 - 相对于所有板块平均运动的速度。箭头随速度增长，起点处的数字单位为毫米/年。太平洋板块以约 70 毫米/年向西北移动，欧亚板块约为 25。“对象”窗口显示该点的板块、速度和方向。

column1: The field before 1900 is not loaded: {error}

column2: gufm1 自 1590 年，IGRF-14 自 1900 年至 2030 年

column1: A wall from the raised object down to the ground, a post for a point. Works with a height above zero.
column2: 从抬升的对象到地面的墙，点则为立柱。高度大于零时生效。

column1: Colour of the placemark label on the globe, as LabelStyle in KML. A dark label gets a light outline.
column2: 地标标注在地球上的颜色，相当于 KML 中的 LabelStyle。深色标注带浅色描边。

column1: Date and time of the view. A flight to the placemark and a tour set the time slider to this time.
column2: 视图的日期和时间。飞往地标和游览会将时间条设为此时间。

column1: Fill color of the polygon, with its transparency. The wall down to the ground takes this color too.
column2: 多边形的填充颜色。透明度也在此设置。到地面的墙也使用此颜色。

column1: Globe layers from the snapshot, rows switched on: {count}
column2: 快照中的地球图层，已开启行数：{count}

column1: Height by slider. The scale is logarithmic, near the ground the step is metres, higher up hundreds of metres and kilometres.
column2: 用滑块设置高度。刻度为对数，近地面时步长为米，较高时为数百米和公里。

column1: How many seconds the camera stays at this tour stop. As in the tour - the pause from the tour panel.
column2: 相机在此游览停靠点停留的秒数。“与游览相同”使用游览面板中的暂停。

column1: How many times faster than usual the tour flies to this placemark. Below one - slower, smoother for a show.
column2: 游览飞往此地标的速度是平常的几倍。小于一则更慢，演示时更平稳。

column1: Icon of the point on the globe and in the list. In KML it goes as the address of a standard icon of the same theme.
column2: 点在地球上和列表中的图标。在 KML 中保存为同主题标准图标的地址。

column1: Icon size as a share of the usual one, as the IconStyle scale in KML. 0 - only the label on the globe.
column2: 图标大小，为常规大小的比例，相当于 KML 中 IconStyle 的 scale。0 表示地球上只显示标注。

column1: Label size as a share of the usual one. 0 - only the icon on the globe, the name stays in the list.
column2: 标注大小，为常规大小的比例。0 表示地球上只显示图标，名称仍保留在列表中。

column1: Object fields, as ExtendedData in KML. The placemark card and the Objects window show them, Explain this passes them to the assistant. A field without a name is not saved.
column2: 对象字段，相当于 KML 中的 ExtendedData。地标卡片和“对象”窗口会显示它们，“解释一下”会将它们传给助手。没有名称的字段不会保存。

column1: Return the view the place had when the window opened.
column2: 恢复打开窗口时地标的视图。

column1: Rows of the Layers section that were switched on at the view snapshot. A flight to the placemark and a tour switch them on and the others off - so a tour stop shows its own layers. A new snapshot of the current view takes them again.
column2: 拍摄视图快照时已开启的“图层”部分的行。飞往地标和游览会开启这些行并关闭其余行 - 这样游览停靠点会显示自己的图层。当前视图的新快照会重新记录它们。

column1: Short dashes of the line colour run along the path from the first point to the last one, like a flow of goods. The path lies on the ground. The setting is kept in KML.
column2: 线条颜色的短划线沿路径从第一个点流向最后一个点，如同货物流。路径贴在地面上。此设置保存在 KML 中。

column1: The fly-around camera is closer to the ground or farther from it in all recorded poses. The middle is the recorded height, the ends are four times lower and four times higher. Path points are dragged with the mouse on the globe, the poses between them follow.
column2: 在所有录制姿态中，使环绕飞行相机更靠近或更远离地面。中间为录制高度，两端分别为四分之一和四倍。可在地球上用鼠标拖动路径点，它们之间的姿态随之变化。

column1: The placemark's own time, as TimeStamp and TimeSpan in KML. A placemark with a time shows while its time falls into the interval of the time slider at the top of the view. A placemark without a time always shows.
column2: 地标自身的时间，相当于 KML 中的 TimeStamp 和 TimeSpan。带时间的地标在其时间落入视图顶部时间条的时间段内时可见。无时间的地标始终可见。

column1: The rise above the surface or the sea floor, in the absolute mode the altitude above sea level.
column2: 高出地表或海底的高度，绝对模式下为海拔高度。

column1: What the altitude is measured from. Clamped to ground - the placemark lies on the ground, over the sea on the water. Clamped to sea floor - on the floor. Relative to ground and to sea floor - the rise above them. Absolute - the altitude above sea level. The mode is saved in KML.
column2: 高度的计算基准。贴地 - 地标位于地面，海上位于水面。贴海底 - 位于海底。相对地面和相对海底 - 高出它们的高度。绝对 - 海拔高度。该模式保存在 KML 中。

column1: Where the camera looks from when it flies to the place or stands at it in a tour. Without a view of its own the camera frames the whole place.
column2: 相机飞往地标或在游览中停留于此时的观察位置。没有自身视图时，相机将整个地标纳入画面。

column1: A linked image is read again after this interval while it is shown. The globe then keeps a fresh image or map that a server or a program updates by itself. Zero - the image is read when shown. An interval shorter than {low} s is raised to {low} s.
column2: 链接的图片在显示期间每隔此时间重新读取。这样地球上就能显示由服务器或程序自行更新的最新影像或地图。零 - 显示时读取图片。短于 {low} 秒的间隔会提高到 {low} 秒。

column1: A linked model file is checked at this interval while the model is visible. A changed file is read again. Zero means the file is read when shown. An interval shorter than {low} s is raised to {low} s.
column2: 链接的模型文件在模型显示期间每隔此时间检查一次。已更改的文件会重新读取。零 - 显示时读取文件。短于 {low} 秒的间隔会提高到 {low} 秒。

column1: A My Places folder with the contents of a KML or KMZ document at an address. The contents are loaded again after the refresh interval, edits inside the folder are lost then.
column2: “我的地点”中的文件夹，内含某地址上 KML 或 KMZ 文档的内容。内容在刷新间隔后重新加载，届时文件夹内的编辑会丢失。

column1: After how many seconds the document is loaded again. Zero is once per session. The interval is never shorter than 10 s.
column2: 文档每隔多少秒重新加载。零表示每次会话一次。间隔不会短于 10 秒。

column1: An edge of the image box in degrees. The box is set by the cardinal sides and the rotation, as LatLonBox in KML.
column2: 图片边框的一条边，以度为单位。边框由东南西北四边和旋转确定，相当于 KML 中的 LatLonBox。

column1: Choose a model file. In the places file the model is replaced by a copy, a link gets a new path. The place and the scale stay.
column2: 选择模型文件。在地标文件中，模型被替换为副本，链接则更换路径。位置和比例保持不变。

column1: Choose an image file. In the places file the image is replaced with a copy, a link gets the new path. The corners and position stay.
column2: 选择图片文件。在地标文件中，图片被替换为副本，链接则更换路径。四角和位置保持不变。

column1: Clockwise turn of the model as seen from above. At zero the Y axis of the model points north.
column2: 从上方看模型顺时针旋转的角度。为零时模型的 Y 轴指向北方。

column1: Close the properties without saving the edits, like the Cancel button.
column2: 关闭属性且不保存编辑，与“取消”按钮相同。

column1: Each corner of the image is dragged with the mouse on its own, the image can become an irregular quadrilateral, as gx:LatLonQuad in KML. It does not convert back to a box.
column2: 可用鼠标单独拖动图片的每个角，图片可变为不规则四边形，相当于 KML 中的 gx:LatLonQuad。无法再转换回边框。
文件路径或 http(s) 地址

column1: Height of the model point. Above terrain is the rise above the ground, above sea level is the height from sea level. On terrain the height has no effect.
column2: 模型点的高度。相对地形 - 高出地面的高度，海拔 - 距海平面的高度。贴合地形时高度不起作用。

column1: Latitude of the model point. The point is the origin of the model file coordinates.
column2: 模型点的纬度。该点是模型文件坐标的原点。

column1: Link to a file or address
Opacity of the image. At zero the imagery shows through it.
column2: 图片的不透明度。为零时可透过它看到影像。

column1: Path to a .dae, .gltf, .glb or .obj model file. The model images are read from the files next to it.
column2: .dae、.gltf、.glb 或 .obj 模型文件的路径。模型的图片从其旁边的文件中读取。

column1: Roll of the model around its Y axis.
column2: 模型绕其 Y 轴的横滚。

column1: Rotation of the image about its centre counterclockwise.
column2: 图片绕其中心逆时针旋转的角度。

column1: Scale of the model. One means the sizes from the model file. The field changes the scale of all axes at once, different axis scales from KML keep their ratio.
column2: 模型比例。一表示模型文件中的尺寸。该字段同时更改所有轴的比例，来自 KML 的各轴不同比例保持其比值。

column1: The address of a KML or KMZ document on the web (http, https) or a file path on disk. The file is read again when another program changes it.
column2: 网络上 KML 或 KMZ 文档的地址 (http, https) 或磁盘上的文件路径。其他程序更改文件时会重新读取。

column1: The corner of the view the image is pinned to.
column2: 图片固定到的视图角落。

column1: The corners of the image are dragged with the mouse on the globe while the window is open.
column2: 窗口打开期间，可在地球上用鼠标拖动图片的角。

column1: The cross in the middle moves the image, the diamond rotates it, the corners and the middles of the sides stretch it, with Shift from the centre.
column2: 中间的十字移动图片，菱形旋转图片，角和边的中点拉伸图片，按住 Shift 则从中心拉伸。

column1: The description of the overlay. It goes into KML with the image.
column2: 叠加层的说明。它随图片一起写入 KML。

column1: The folder name in My Places.
The name of the overlay in My Places.
column2: 叠加层在“我的地点”中的名称。

column1: The network link {name} was not loaded, {error}
The path to the image file or its web address. The image is read again at each showing.
column2: 图片文件的路径或其网络地址。每次显示时都会重新读取图片。

column1: The time of the image, as in KML. A year or a date is a moment, for a historical map it is the map year. Moment maps of one folder replace each other on the time slider - the last map not later than the slider moment is shown. Two values with a slash are a span, the image is shown within it. An empty field shows the image always.
column2: 图片的时间，与 KML 相同。年份或日期表示时刻，对历史地图而言是地图的年份。同一文件夹中的时刻地图在时间条上相互替换 - 显示不晚于时间条时刻的最后一幅地图。用斜杠分隔的两个值表示时间段，图片在其中可见。字段为空时图片始终可见。

column1: Tilt of the model around its X axis.
column2: 模型绕其 X 轴的倾斜。
三角形 {count}，材质 {parts}，图片 {images}。尺寸 {x} × {y} × {z} 米。

column1: What the model height is measured from, as altitudeMode in KML.
column2: 模型高度的计算基准，相当于 KML 中的 altitudeMode。

column1: Where the image lies. In the places file - a copy inside My Places, it is shown without the source file. Link - a file path or a web address, the image is read when shown, an edit of the file shows on the globe.
column2: 图片存放位置。在地标文件中 - “我的地点”内的副本，没有源文件也可见。链接 - 文件路径或网址，显示时读取图片，对文件的编辑会在地球上显示。

column1: Where the model files are. A link is a path to a .dae, .gltf, .glb or .obj file, the model is read from it and the files next to it, an edit in SketchUp or Blender shows on the globe. In the places file is a copy of all model files, it shows without the source file too.
column2: 模型文件存放位置。链接是 .dae、.gltf、.glb 或 .obj 文件的路径，模型从该文件及其旁边的文件读取，在 SketchUp 或 Blender 中的编辑会在地球上显示。在地标文件中 - 所有模型文件的副本，没有源文件也可见。

column1: Width of the image as a share of the view width. Zero - the image at its own size in pixels.
column2: 图片宽度占视图宽度的比例。零 - 图片按自身像素大小显示。

column1: Stars of the Yale Bright Star Catalogue. The stars show from space and fade when the camera descends into the atmosphere.
column2: 来自 Yale Bright Star Catalogue 的恒星。从太空可见恒星，相机下降到大气层中时恒星逐渐消失。

column1: Source of the globe imagery. The terms of use of each source are in the Data sources window.
column2: 地球影像的来源。各来源的使用条件见“数据来源”窗口。

column1: All globe sources with their terms of use.
column2: 地球的所有来源及其使用条件。

column1: Multiplier of terrain heights. Above 1 mountains and valleys stand out more, and flat terrain becomes visible. The camera stays above the raised surface. After a change the globe rebuilds the surface within a few seconds.
column2: 地形高度倍数。大于 1 时山脉和山谷更加突出，平坦地形也变得可见。相机始终位于抬升后的地表之上。更改后地球会在几秒内重建地表。

column1: Language of place, water, peak and other labels on the globe. "As the interface" takes the interface language. If a name in the chosen language is missing, the Latin or local name is shown. Labels change at once.
column2: 地球上地名、水体、山峰及其他标注的语言。“与界面相同”使用界面语言。若所选语言中没有名称，则显示拉丁字母名称或当地名称。标注立即更改。

column1: How coordinates are written in the status line and the Features window. The Search field understands all four formats whatever the choice. North of 84° and south of 80° UTM and MGRS are replaced with decimal degrees.
column2: 状态栏和“对象”窗口中坐标的书写方式。“搜索”字段无论如何选择都能识别全部四种格式。在北纬 84° 以北和南纬 80° 以南，UTM 和 MGRS 由十进制度代替。

column1: Look of the globe window. Light - grey plates with dark icons and light windows. Dark - dark plates and dark windows. The look changes at once.
column2: 地球窗口的外观。“浅色” - 灰色面板配深色图标和浅色窗口。“深色” - 深色面板和深色窗口。外观立即更改。

column1: Language of menus, windows and messages. "As in the system" takes the language of the system.
column2: 菜单、窗口和消息的语言。“跟随系统”使用系统语言。

column1: Erase the previous queries of the Search field.
column2: 清除“搜索”字段之前的查询。

column1: With the box checked the sea and ocean floor lies at its depths under semi-transparent water, the status bar shows the depth under the cursor, and the elevation profile shows depths and sea level. Without it heights below sea level count as zero and the sea is flat. Exists only on the Earth.
column2: 勾选后，海洋底部位于其深度处，上方为半透明的水，状态栏显示光标下的深度，高程剖面显示深度和海平面。不勾选时，海平面以下的高度计为零，海面平坦。仅适用于地球。

column1: The route start is set. The end is the Directions to here item of the globe menu.
column2: 已设置路线起点。终点为地球菜单中的“到这里规划路线”项。

column1: The route end is set. The start is the Directions from here item of the globe menu.
column2: 已设置路线终点。起点为地球菜单中的“从这里规划路线”项。

column1: No route: the service answered '{error}', and over the roads of the vector base a route is built up to {limit} km in a straight line.
column2: 未能规划路线：服务回复“{error}”，而沿矢量底图的道路只能规划直线距离 {limit} 公里以内的路线。

column1: No route: the corridor between the points is {count} road tiles, the limit is {limit}.
column2: 未能规划路线：两点之间的走廊包含 {count} 个道路瓦片，上限为 {limit}。

column1: No route found: the points are not linked by the vector base roads or lie more than {reach} m from them.
column2: 未找到路线：两点未由矢量底图的道路连通，或距道路超过 {reach} 米。

column1: The service did not answer ({error}), route over road tiles
column2: 服务未响应（{error}），按道路瓦片规划路线

column1: Opacity of the surface. Lower - drill holes and bed roofs show through the terrain.
column2: 地表不透明度。调低后可透过地形看到钻孔和地层顶面。

column1: Remove the surface and the roofs inside the cut polygon. The beds show along the cut edge, the model bottom at its floor.
column2: 移除切割多边形内的地表和顶面。切口边缘可见地层，底部可见模型底面。

column1: The camera goes below the terrain down to the model bottom inside its frame. Above the model the camera moves along its bottom, not along the terrain.
column2: 相机在模型范围内下降到地形以下，直至模型底面。在模型上方，相机沿模型底面而非地形移动。

column1: The Subsurface mode window - surface transparency above the model, the block cut and the camera under the ground. The data is a GeoPackage file with drill holes, bed roofs, sections and tunnels, open it like any other file.
column2: “地下模式”窗口 - 模型上方地表的透明度、块体切割和地下相机。数据为包含钻孔、地层顶面、剖面和隧道的 GeoPackage 文件，可像其他文件一样打开。

column1: No subsurface data: open a GeoPackage file with drill holes, bed roofs or tunnels.
column2: 没有地下数据：请打开包含钻孔、地层顶面或隧道的 GeoPackage 文件。

column1: The sea and ocean floor below zero and water above it. Without the check the sea surface is flat, at zero.
column2: 零以下的海洋底部及其上方的水。不勾选时海面平坦，位于零高度。

column1: Opacity of the ground above the subsurface model - grids by elevations, roofs, drill holes. To the right the ground is opaque, to the left more transparent, at the left edge it is not seen. Outside the data outline the ground does not change.
column2: 地下模型（高程网格、地层顶面、钻孔）上方地面的不透明度。向右地面不透明，向左更透明，在最左端则不可见。数据范围外的地面不变。

column1: The Subsurface mode window - the block cut and the camera under the ground.
column2: “地下模式”窗口 - 块体切割和地下相机。

column1: Opacity of the layer. To the right the layer is opaque, to the left more transparent.
column2: 图层的不透明度。向右图层不透明，向左更透明。

column1: Removes a sector of the Earth under the look-at point, a quarter of a hemisphere 90° wide in longitude. Its faces show the crust, the mantle and the core by the radii of the PREM model, the crust by the CRUST1.0 model. Where a face crosses a subduction zone, the subducting slab shows on it. The sector is placed anew each time the row is switched on.
column2: 从注视点下方的地球中移除一个扇区 - 经度宽 90° 的四分之一半球。其剖面按 PREM 模型的半径显示地壳、地幔和地核，按 CRUST1.0 模型显示地壳。剖面穿过俯冲带的地方可见俯冲板块。每次开启该行时扇区都会重新放置。

column1: Stretches depths to 400 km, the more the farther the camera, and the crust and the upper mantle show from afar. Without the check all depths are in true scale.
column2: 相机越远，对 400 公里以内深度的拉伸越强，从远处也能看到地壳和上地幔。不勾选时所有深度均为真实比例。

column1: Remove this tile source from the list.
column2: 从列表中移除此瓦片来源。

column1: Address template of the tiles with the places {z}, {x} and {y}. {-y} - rows from bottom to top, as in TMS.
column2: 含 {z}、{x} 和 {y} 占位的瓦片地址模板。{-y} 表示行自下而上，与 TMS 相同。

column1: Credit of the source on the screen, as its terms of use require.
column2: 按其使用条件要求在屏幕上显示的来源署名。

column1: The address must begin with https:// or http://.
column2: 地址必须以 https:// 或 http:// 开头。

column1: The address needs the places {z}, {x} and {y} or {-y}.
column2: 地址需要 {z}、{x} 和 {y} 或 {-y} 占位。

column1: The address must not contain spaces.

Wikipedia articles with coordinates - cities, monuments, rivers, peaks - as labels with a blue dot. The articles are requested when the camera is below 40 km, in the language of the QGIS interface. A click on a label opens the article card - the first paragraph, a link to the article and the Explain this button. Wikipedia texts are under CC BY-SA 4.0.
column2: 带坐标的维基百科条目 - 城市、纪念物、河流、山峰 - 以带蓝点的标注显示。相机低于 40 公里时，以 QGIS 界面语言请求条目。单击标注打开条目卡片 - 第一段、条目链接和“解释一下”按钮。维基百科文本采用 CC BY-SA 4.0。

column1: Clouds from NASA GIBS VIIRS imagery of the last complete day. They lie as a translucent veil over the imagery. Snow and ice are white too and stay visible.
column2: 根据 NASA GIBS 最近一整天 VIIRS 影像的云层。云层以半透明薄纱覆盖在影像之上。雪和冰同样为白色，仍然可见。

column1: Artificial satellites from CelesTrak orbital elements, positions by the SGP4 model. The time is the right handle of the time slider, without the slider the computer clock. The Satellites tab of the gallery chooses the groups. The elements of a group update at most once in 2 hours.
column2: 根据 CelesTrak 轨道根数的人造卫星，位置按 SGP4 模型计算。时间为时间条的右滑块，没有时间条时为计算机时钟。分组在图库的“卫星”选项卡中选择。分组的根数最多每 2 小时更新一次。

column1: Outlines of open pits, waste dumps, tailings and industrial sites of the world from Sentinel-2 images of 2019 - about 45 thousand areas, Maus et al., 2022. A click on an outline shows the country and area. The first switch-on downloads about 25 MB.
column2: 根据 2019 年 Sentinel-2 影像的世界露天矿、排土场、尾矿库和工业场地轮廓 - 约 4.5 万处，Maus 等，2022。单击轮廓显示国家和面积。首次打开下载约 25 MB。

column1: Mines, shafts and quarries from OpenStreetMap with names and the commodity. They load for the place of the view when the camera is below 150 km. The colour is the commodity group, as for the deposits. A click on a point shows the name, operator and a link to the OpenStreetMap object.
column2: OpenStreetMap 中带名称和矿种的矿山、竖井和采石场。相机低于 150 公里时按视图位置加载。颜色为矿种组，与矿床相同。单击点显示名称、运营方和 OpenStreetMap 对象的链接。

column1: Trains of Finland in real time from Fintraffic Digitraffic open data, the positions are updated every 10 s. From afar a train is a dot in the colour of its category with its number, close up it is a car model that moves along OpenStreetMap rails between updates. A click on a train shows its type, number and speed.
column2: 根据 Fintraffic Digitraffic 开放数据的芬兰实时列车，位置每 10 秒更新一次。远看列车是带车次的类别颜色点，近看则是在两次更新之间沿 OpenStreetMap 铁轨行驶的车厢模型。单击列车显示类型、车次和速度。

column1: Ships of the Gulfs of Finland and Bothnia and the Baltic near Finland by AIS signals, Fintraffic Digitraffic open data, the positions every 20 s. From afar a ship is a dot in the colour of its type with its name, close up a schematic model of its length that keeps its course. A click shows the type, call sign, destination, size and speed.
column2: 根据 AIS 信号的芬兰湾、波的尼亚湾和芬兰附近波罗的海的船舶，Fintraffic Digitraffic 开放数据，位置每 20 秒更新。远看船舶是带船名的类型颜色点，近看则是保持航向、与船长相符的示意模型。单击显示类型、呼号、目的地、尺寸和速度。

column1: Aircraft by ADS-B signals of the adsb.lol volunteer network in a circle around the point of view, every 10 s. An aircraft in the air is shown at its altitude, close up as a schematic model of the size of its category with its bank. A click shows the call sign, type, registration, altitude and speed. The network has almost no receivers over Russia.
column2: 根据 adsb.lol 志愿者网络 ADS-B 信号的视点周围圆形范围内的飞机，每 10 秒更新。空中飞机显示在其高度上，近看为与其类别大小相符、带坡度的示意模型。单击显示呼号、机型、注册号、高度和速度。该网络在俄罗斯上空几乎没有接收器。

column1: Ocean surface currents as white running streaks over a speed colouring. Geostrophic currents of NOAA CoastWatch from satellite altimetry for the latest ready day, 0.5° grid. The first switch-on in a session downloads about 4 MB.
column2: 以速度着色之上流动的白色细线表示的海洋表层流。根据卫星测高的 NOAA CoastWatch 地转流，最近完成的一天，0.5° 格网。会话中首次打开下载约 4 MB。

column1: OSM power lines, cables and pipelines
column2: OSM 输电线、电缆和管道

column1: Power lines by voltage, substations, cables and gas, oil and water pipelines from OpenStreetMap. They load for the place in view when the camera is below 150 km. A click on a line shows the voltage, substance, operator and a link to the OpenStreetMap object.
column2: OpenStreetMap 中按电压分的输电线、变电站、电缆以及燃气、石油和水管道。相机低于 150 公里时按视图位置加载。单击线条显示电压、输送物、运营方和 OpenStreetMap 对象的链接。

column1: Strong earthquakes of the world from 1904 to 2024 from the ISC-GEM catalogue - about 74 thousand events of magnitude 5 and above, with locations, depths and magnitudes recomputed in one way. A circle sits at the epicentre, at its depth - in the removed sector of the Earth cutaway, the colour shows the depth and the size the magnitude. The time slider range selects the events. A click on a circle shows the place, date, magnitude and the USGS event page. The first use downloads the catalogue in parts, about 13 MB.
column2: 根据 ISC-GEM 目录的 1904 年至 2024 年世界强震 - 约 7.4 万次 5 级及以上事件，位置、深度和震级按统一方法重新计算。圆圈位于震中，在其深度处 - 位于地球剖面的移除扇区中，颜色表示深度，大小表示震级。时间条的时间段筛选事件。单击圆圈显示地点、日期、震级和 USGS 事件页面。首次打开分批下载目录，约 13 MB。

column1: The shape of the Earth level surface - the geoid - after the NGA EGM2008 model. While the row is on, the globe heights are the geoid heights above the ellipsoid, from -107 to +86 m, stretched 10 000 times, and the Earth looks crumpled. Bulges are where gravity is stronger, for example near New Guinea, hollows where it is weaker, the deepest one in the Indian Ocean. Terrain and water are removed for this time, switching the row off brings them back.
column2: 根据 NGA EGM2008 模型的地球等位面 - 大地水准面 - 的形状。该行开启期间，地球高度为大地水准面相对椭球的高度，从 -107 到 +86 米，拉伸 10 000 倍，地球看起来“皱巴巴”的。隆起位于重力较强处，例如新几内亚附近，凹陷位于重力较弱处，最深的在印度洋。此期间地形和水被移除，关闭该行即可恢复。

column1: Land relief and sea depths in the past, up to 540 million years ago, after the PALEOMAP PaleoDEM maps. The slider at the bottom of the view sets the age. The imagery, borders and labels are removed meanwhile.
column2: 根据 PALEOMAP PaleoDEM 地图的过去陆地地形和海洋深度，最远至 5.4 亿年前。年代由视图底部的滑块设置。此期间影像、边界和标注被移除。

column1: 3D buildings from OpenStreetMap in OpenFreeMap vector tiles. They show when the camera is closer than 6 km to the ground. The height comes from OSM or from the number of floors. A building without either gets a height of 5 m.
column2: OpenFreeMap 矢量瓦片中的 OpenStreetMap 3D 建筑。相机距地面不到 6 公里时可见。高度取自 OSM 或楼层数。两者均无的建筑高度为 5 米。
俄罗斯国家登记局地籍

column1: Land parcels from the National spatial data system of Rosreestr over the imagery, for Russia only. They are seen up close, from about 10 km and lower. The service answers slowly and refuses frequent requests, so the parcels come one tile at a time.
column2: 俄罗斯国家登记局国家空间数据系统中的地块，叠加在影像上，仅限俄罗斯。近处可见，自约 10 公里高度及以下。该服务响应缓慢并拒绝频繁请求，因此地块逐个瓦片到达。

column1: Age in millions of years ago. The map of relief and depths for this age - PaleoDEM PALEOMAP, Scotese and Wright 2018.
column2: 以百万年前为单位的年代。此年代的地形和深度地图 - PaleoDEM PALEOMAP，Scotese 和 Wright 2018。

column1: Show from the chosen age to the present through all maps of the set.
column2: 从所选年代到现今依次播放该组的所有地图。

column1: How many times the geoid heights above the ellipsoid are stretched. To the right the bulges and hollows are deeper, to the left the Earth is rounder.
column2: 大地水准面相对椭球的高度拉伸的倍数。向右隆起和凹陷更深，向左地球更圆。

column1: Trains of Finland, Baltic ships and aircraft in real time from Fintraffic open data and the adsb.lol ADS-B network.
column2: 根据 Fintraffic 开放数据和 adsb.lol ADS-B 网络的实时芬兰列车、波罗的海船舶和飞机。

column1: Touched the ground - the flight is over.
Up to 2000 km/h, start at 900 km/h, sharp bank.
column2: 最高 2000 公里/小时，以 900 公里/小时起飞，急剧倾斜。

column1: Up to 340 km/h, start at 250 km/h, smooth.
column2: 最高 340 公里/小时，以 250 公里/小时起飞，平稳。

column1: {speed} km/h · altitude {alt} m, above ground {height} m · heading {heading}° · climb {climb} m/s · throttle {throttle} %
column2: {speed} 公里/小时 · 高度 {alt} 米，离地 {height} 米 · 航向 {heading}° · 爬升 {climb} 米/秒 · 推力 {throttle} %

column1: ↑ ↓ - nose down and up · ← → - bank · PageUp, PageDown - throttle · V - cockpit view · H - instruments · Esc - exit
column2: ↑ ↓ - 机头向下和向上 · ← → - 倾斜 · PageUp, PageDown - 推力 · V - 座舱视角 · H - 仪表 · Esc - 退出

column1: A click on a row copies the sheet number to the clipboard.
column2: 单击某行可将图幅编号复制到剪贴板。

column1: A click on a row copies the sheet number. Sheets of the Russian State Geological Map at 1:1,000,000 and 1:200,000 use the Russian designation too.
column2: 单击某行可复制图幅编号。俄罗斯国家地质图 1:1 000 000 和 1:200 000 的图幅也采用俄罗斯图幅编号。

column1: A ready site from the list or an empty row for your own address.
column2: 列表中的现成网站，或用于自定义地址的空行。
在窗口中显示全部编号…

column1: Each row is an item of the Open in browser submenu of the globe menu. The item opens the site at the point under the cursor. Add site puts a ready site or an empty row for your own address. In the address {lat} and {lon} are the latitude and longitude in degrees, {zoom} is the map scale by the view.
column2: 每一行都是地球菜单中“在浏览器中打开”子菜单的一项。该项在光标下的点打开网站。“添加网站”添加现成网站或用于自定义地址的空行。地址中的 {lat} 和 {lon} 是以度为单位的纬度和经度，{zoom} 是按视图确定的地图比例。
国际百万分之一世界地图 (IMW)

column1: Sites of the Open in browser menu
column2: “在浏览器中打开”菜单的网站

column1: The address does not start with https:// or http://.
column2: 地址不是以 https:// 或 http:// 开头。

column1: The address has extra braces or places other than {lat}, {lon} and {zoom}.
column2: 地址中有多余的花括号或 {lat}、{lon} 和 {zoom} 以外的占位。
此处的“埃托·梅斯托”旧地图…

column1: Height above the terrain of what has to be seen, for example a mast or a building. At zero the ground itself is checked.
column2: 需要看到的目标（如桅杆或建筑物）高出地形的高度。为零时检查地面本身。

column1: Height of the eye or mast above the terrain at the point. A higher value sees farther and fewer places stay hidden behind the terrain.
column2: 该点处眼睛或桅杆高出地形的高度。越高看得越远，被地形遮挡的地方越少。

column1: Keeps the maps whose title or year holds all the words.
column2: 保留标题或年份包含所有词语的地图。

column1: Maps at the point {total}, shown {shown}. A click on a title opens the map on the site.
column2: 该点的地图 {total} 幅，已显示 {shown} 幅。单击标题在网站上打开地图。

column1: Maps of the Eto Mesto site (etomesto.com) that cover the point. A map opens on the site, where it can be overlaid on a modern map and downloaded under the site rules.
column2: 覆盖该点的“埃托·梅斯托”网站 (etomesto.com) 地图。地图在网站上打开，可在网站上叠加到现代地图上，并按网站规则下载。

column1: Not all heights are loaded, the computation used less detailed ones.
column2: 未加载全部高度，计算使用了较粗的高度。

column1: Opens the page of the chosen map on etomesto.com in the browser.
column2: 在浏览器中打开所选地图在 etomesto.com 上的页面。

column1: Over {days} days direct sun shines from {low} to {high} h per day. The grid step is {step} m.
column2: 在 {days} 天内，直射阳光每天照射 {low} 至 {high} 小时。网格步长为 {step} 米。

column1: Radius of the computed circle. A larger radius gives a coarser grid. Mountain shadows are taken from a distance of at least the radius and at least 5 km.
column2: 计算圆的半径。越大网格越粗。山体阴影从不小于半径且不小于 5 公里的距离起计入。

column1: Radius of the computed circle. A larger radius gives a coarser step, the step is about one five-hundredth of the radius.
column2: 计算圆的半径。越大步长越粗，步长约为半径的五百分之一。

column1: Remove the insolation layer from the globe.
column2: 从地球上移除日照图层。

column1: Remove the viewshed layer from the globe.
column2: 从地球上移除可视域图层。

column1: The first day of the period. The result is the mean number of hours of direct sunlight per day over the period.
column2: 时段的第一天。结果是时段内每天直射阳光的平均小时数。

column1: The last day of the period, inclusive. A long period is computed over 15 evenly spaced days.
column2: 时段的最后一天（含）。较长时段按均匀选取的 15 天计算。

column1: The site has no maps at this point.
{share} of the circle area is visible. The computation step is {step} m.
column2: 可见圆面积的 {share}。计算步长为 {step} 米。

column1: Wikipedia articles with coordinates near the look-at point. A click on an article gives its link and first paragraph.
column2: 注视点附近带坐标的维基百科条目。单击条目可获得其链接和第一段。

column1: Wikipedia did not answer, retry in 30 s.
column2: 维基百科未响应，30 秒后重试。

column1: Wikipedia articles with coordinates near the look-at point, the important and the near ones first. They show below 40 km of camera height. A click on an article gives its link and first paragraph in the Objects window.
column2: 注视点附近带坐标的维基百科条目，重要和较近的条目优先。相机高度低于 40 公里时可见。单击条目可在“对象”窗口中获得其链接和第一段。

column1: CelesTrak refused the group, a new request goes 2 hours after the refusal.
column2: CelesTrak 拒绝了该分组，拒绝 2 小时后发出新请求。

column1: Groups of artificial satellites from CelesTrak. A click on a group shows it on the globe or removes it.
column2: CelesTrak 的人造卫星分组。单击分组可在地球上显示或移除它。

column1: The answer has no orbital elements.
The International Space Station, the Chinese Tiangong station and the spacecraft docked to them.
column2: 国际空间站、中国天宫空间站以及与它们对接的飞船。

column1: About a hundred satellites and rocket stages visible from the Earth without binoculars.
column2: 约一百颗无需望远镜即可从地球上看到的卫星和火箭末级。

column1: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou satellites on medium orbits of about 20 000 km and geosynchronous ones.
column2: 位于约 20 000 公里中轨道和地球同步轨道上的 GPS、格洛纳斯、Galileo 和 BeiDou 卫星。

column1: Weather satellites on polar and geostationary orbits.
column2: 位于极地轨道和地球静止轨道上的气象卫星。

column1: Earth imaging satellites, Landsat and Sentinel among them.
column2: 对地成像卫星，包括 Landsat 和 Sentinel。

column1: Science satellites and observatories on Earth orbits.
column2: 位于地球轨道上的科学卫星和天文台。

column1: Active satellites on the geosynchronous orbit, about 36 000 km above the equator. They stay almost still over the Earth.
column2: 位于赤道上空约 36 000 公里地球同步轨道上的在役卫星。它们在地球上方几乎静止不动。

column1: SpaceX communication satellites at 340-570 km, thousands of them. Loading and the first calculation take longer than for other groups.
column2: 位于 340-570 公里高度的 SpaceX 通信卫星，数以千计。加载和首次计算比其他分组耗时更长。

column1: OneWeb communication satellites at about 1200 km.
column2: 位于约 1200 公里高度的 OneWeb 通信卫星。

column1: Power line below 110 kV or without voltage
column2: 110 kV 以下或无电压的输电线路

column1: The OpenStreetMap server did not answer, the request will repeat by itself.
column2: OpenStreetMap 服务器未响应，请求将自动重试。

column1: Loading mining area outlines, about 25 MB…
column2: 正在加载采矿区轮廓，约 25 MB…

column1: Mining area outlines are not written: {error}
Mining area outlines did not load, check the network and switch the row on again.
column2: 采矿区轮廓未能加载，请检查网络并重新开启该行。

column1: The mining area outline file cannot be read: {path}
column2: 无法读取采矿区轮廓文件：{path}

column1: Volumetric buildings from OpenStreetMap by the OpenFreeMap vector tiles. They show when the camera is closer than 6 km to the ground. The height comes from OSM, otherwise from the number of floors. A building without these data gets a height of 5 m.
column2: OpenFreeMap 矢量瓦片中的 OpenStreetMap 3D 建筑。相机距地面不到 6 公里时可见。高度取自 OSM 或楼层数。两者均无的建筑高度为 5 米。

column1: Currents did not load, check the network and switch the row on again.
column2: 洋流未能加载，请检查网络并重新开启该行。

column1: Search by title and year among all maps of the collection, not only at the view. The Show on the globe button flies to the chosen map.
column2: 按标题和年份在收藏的全部地图中搜索，而不仅限于视图。“在地球上显示”按钮飞往所选地图。

column1: Flight to the frame of the chosen map.
The map page on the collection site in the browser.
column2: 在浏览器中打开收藏网站上的地图页面。

column1: The Rumsey map catalogue did not load, check the network.
column2: Rumsey 地图目录未能加载，请检查网络。
此处的 Rumsey 历史地图…

column1: Maps of the David Rumsey collection, georeferenced by its control points. The images are CC BY-NC-SA 3.0: non-commercial use only, with credit to the source.
column2: David Rumsey 收藏的地图，按其控制点配准。图像采用 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0：仅限非商业用途，并须注明来源。

column1: Maps at the view: {count}, by year. A click on a column header changes the order.
column2: 视图中的地图：{count} 幅，按年份排列。单击列标题可更改顺序。

column1: The map is on the globe: {title}.
The map is built from the collection image, georeferenced and laid as a picture on the surface in My Places, folder Rumsey maps, with the year of the map. The year puts the map on the time slider.
column2: 地图由收藏图像生成，经配准后连同地图年份作为地表图片放入“我的地点”的“Rumsey 地图”文件夹。年份把地图放到时间条上。

column1: The image is on the globe: {name}.
Landsat 4-9 Collection 2 Level-2 (USGS), files and catalogue of Microsoft Planetary Computer. The layers carry the credit "Landsat image courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey".
column2: Landsat 4-9 Collection 2 Level-2 (USGS)，Microsoft Planetary Computer 的文件和目录。图层带有署名“Landsat image courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey”。

column1: The scene has no UTM system.
column2: 场景没有 UTM 坐标系。

column1: The product of the chosen scene over the area as a picture on the surface in My Places, folder Satellite images, with the day of the image.
column2: 所选场景在该区域上的产品，连同成像日期作为地表图片放入“我的地点”的“卫星影像”文件夹。
搜索的最后一个成像日。

column1: The area is outside the UTM zone of the scene.
column2: 该区域在场景的 UTM 带之外。

column1: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA), files and the Earth Search catalogue by Element 84 on AWS. Layers carry the Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data notice with the image year.
column2: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA)，AWS 上 Element 84 的文件和 Earth Search 目录。图层带有署名“Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data”及成像年份。

column1: Planetary Computer did not give a key for the Landsat files.
column2: Planetary Computer 未提供 Landsat 文件的密钥。

column1: The area has no data in this scene.
column2: 场景在该区域上没有数据。

column1: False colour, near infrared (B8 B4 B3)
column2: 假彩色，近红外 (B8 B4 B3)

column1: Only in the desktop program - the service does not give its data to a web page.
column2: 仅限桌面程序 - 该服务不向网页提供数据。

column1: The field before 1900 is only in the desktop program.
column2: 1900 年以前的磁场仅在桌面程序中提供。

column1: How deep the section goes. 700 km is the bottom of the transition zone, there are almost no earthquakes deeper. 2891 km is the core boundary, 6371 km is the centre of the Earth.
column2: 剖面的深度。700 公里是过渡带底部，更深处几乎没有地震。2891 公里是地核边界，6371 公里是地心。

column1: Width of the band along the line from which earthquake foci are moved onto the section. A wider band gives more foci, but distant foci do not lie where the line is.
column2: 沿线条的带宽，带内的地震震源投影到剖面上。带越宽震源越多，但远处的震源并不在线条所在的位置。

column1: A path of at least two points is needed.
column2: 需要至少有两个点的路径。

column1: Length {length}, depth {depth}. Earthquake foci in the band {count}.
column2: 长度 {length}，深度 {depth}。带内地震震源 {count}。

column1: CRUST1.0 crust, PREM shells, depth, km
column2: CRUST1.0 地壳，PREM 圈层，深度，公里

column1: The CRUST1.0 crust model is not loaded, the crust is a PREM layer.
column2: 未加载 CRUST1.0 地壳模型，地壳为 PREM 的一层。

column1: Body of the globe - a planet, a moon or a dwarf planet. Each body has its own imagery, Mars and the Moon also have terrain. Earth layers, search and buildings are off on other bodies.
column2: 地球仪显示的天体 - 行星、卫星或矮行星。每个天体都有自己的影像，火星和月球还有地形。在其他天体上，地球图层、搜索和建筑处于关闭状态。

column1: Only on the Earth. The menu «Body» returns the Earth to the globe.
column2: 仅限地球。“天体”菜单可将地球恢复到地球仪上。

column1: The starry sky from the centre of the celestial sphere: stars, constellations, the Sun, the Moon and the planets. Dragging turns the sky, the wheel changes the field of view.
column2: 从天球中心看到的星空：恒星、星座、太阳、月球和行星。拖动可旋转天空，滚轮可改变视场。

column1: Figure lines and names of the constellations in the sky. Without them the stars, their names and the Sun, the Moon and the planets remain.
column2: 天空中的星座连线和名称。关闭后仍保留恒星及其名称、太阳、月球和行星。

column1: Labels of galaxies, nebulae and clusters of the Messier, NGC and IC catalogues. A click on a label opens the card of the object.
column2: 梅西耶、NGC 和 IC 星表中星系、星云和星团的标注。单击标注可打开天体卡片。

column1: Closer than a field of view of about 50° the detailed NASA sky map appears instead of the Milky Way picture, closer than 6° - the DSS survey images. Without the check the sky is the Milky Way picture and the catalogue stars.
column2: 视场小于约 50° 时，NASA 的详细星图取代银河图片出现，小于 6° 时出现 DSS 巡天影像。不勾选时，天空为银河图片和星表中的恒星。

column1: Demo: prepared scenes with placemarks and tours on the Earth, Mars, the Moon and in the sky. The placemarks go to a new folder of My Places, the ▶ button under the list plays the tour.
column2: 演示：地球、火星、月球和天空上带有地标和游览的预制场景。地标作为新文件夹放入“我的地点”，列表下方的 ▶ 按钮播放游览。

column1: The program is free and open source.

column2: 通过 SBP 使用俄罗斯银行卡。

column1: Volumetric buildings of Overture Maps - OpenStreetMap together with the open sets of Microsoft, Google Open Buildings and Esri in one PMTiles archive. Where OpenStreetMap is incomplete, for example in Africa and Asia, there are more buildings. They show when the camera is closer than 6 km to the ground. The height is the height field, otherwise the number of floors times 3.66 m. The row replaces the 3D buildings of the vector base.
column2: Overture Maps 立体建筑——OpenStreetMap 与 Microsoft、Google Open Buildings 和 Esri 的开放数据集合为一个 PMTiles 档案。在 OpenStreetMap 不完整的地方，例如非洲和亚洲，建筑更多。相机离地面不到 6 公里时显示。高度取高度字段，否则为楼层数乘以 3.66 米。此行替代矢量底图的三维建筑。
全部 NASA GIBS 图层

column1: The whole NASA GIBS catalog - more than a thousand raster layers of imagery and maps. The list comes from the GIBS catalog on the first show of the category or on a search from three characters. The search finds a layer by all words of the query, the layer names are in English. These rows are not shown in «All».
column2: 完整的 NASA GIBS 目录——一千多个影像和地图栅格图层。首次显示该类别或搜索三个字符以上时，列表从 GIBS 目录获取。搜索按查询的所有词查找图层，图层名称为英文。这些行不显示在“全部”中。

column1: The NASA GIBS catalog is loading, the first time about 10 seconds.
column2: 正在加载 NASA GIBS 目录，首次约 10 秒。

column1: NASA GIBS layers - also one map on the globe
column2: NASA GIBS 图层——同样地球上只有一张地图

column1: A layer of the whole NASA GIBS catalog. It behaves as a theme - one map on the globe, the series of dates goes to the time slider, the colour scale is in the legend. The names of the layers are in English.
column2: 完整 NASA GIBS 目录中的图层。它的行为与主题相同——地球上一张地图，日期序列进入时间滑块，色标在图例中。图层名称为英文。

column1: The NASA GIBS catalog did not load: {error}
Spring 2020 orthophoto of nine counties around Philadelphia (USA), the Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access service. The service is slow, pictures arrive in a few seconds.
column2: 美国费城周边九个县 2020 年春季正射影像，Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access 服务。服务较慢，图片几秒后到达。

column1: A map from a WMS service added in the window «New tile source». The globe asks the service for a picture of each tile in Web Mercator. Outside the area of the layer the base map of the globe is seen.
column2: 在“新瓦片源”窗口中添加的 WMS 服务地图。地球向服务请求每个瓦片的 Web Mercator 图片。图层范围以外显示地球底图。

column1: Detailed imagery and maps of separate areas from the services of their owners, over the base map of the globe. Outside the area the base map is seen. Own WMS services of the window «New tile source» are here too.
column2: 来自所有者服务的各地区详细影像和地图，叠加在地球底图之上。区域以外显示底图。“新瓦片源”窗口添加的 WMS 服务也在这里。

column1: Address template of the tiles with the places {z}, {x} and {y}. {-y} - rows from bottom to top, as in TMS. Or the address of a WMS service - the window knows it by the words WMSServer, /wms or service=WMS and reads the list of its layers.
column2: 带有 {z}、{x} 和 {y} 位置的瓦片地址模板。{-y} 表示自下而上的行，与 TMS 相同。也可以是 WMS 服务地址——窗口根据 WMSServer、/wms 或 service=WMS 识别它并读取其图层列表。

column1: Read the list of layers of the service, the GetCapabilities request.
column2: 读取服务的图层列表，即 GetCapabilities 请求。

column1: The service did not give its layers: {error}
A WMS map lies over the base map of the globe, outside the area of the layer the base map is seen. The service draws each picture anew, so the map loads slower than tiles.
column2: WMS 地图叠加在地球底图之上，图层范围以外显示底图。服务每次重新绘制图片，因此地图加载比瓦片慢。

column1: Images of earthquakes, floods, fires and hurricanes from the open catalogs of Vantor and Planet. The license of the images is CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial use only.
column2: 来自 Vantor 和 Planet 开放目录的地震、洪水、火灾和飓风影像。影像许可为 CC BY-NC 4.0——仅限非商业用途。

column1: The list of events did not load: {error}
The last day of images before the event.
column2: 事件前最后一个影像日。

column1: The last day of images of the event.
column2: 事件的最后一个影像日。

column1: Loading the images of the event: catalog documents {count}
column2: 正在加载事件影像：目录文档 {count}

column1: The event has no images the globe can show.
column2: 该事件没有地球可以显示的影像。

column1: Images: {count}, days of survey: {days}. The buttons below choose the day.
column2: 影像：{count}，拍摄天数：{days}。下方按钮选择日期。

column1: Loading the images of the event «{title}»…

Images of earthquakes, floods, fires and hurricanes from two open catalogs. Vantor (formerly Maxar) gives WorldView strips, Planet - PlanetScope, SkySat and Pelican scenes and the quarterly Planet mosaic before the event. The row opens the window «Event imagery» with the list of events. The license of the images is CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial use only.
column2: 来自两个开放目录的地震、洪水、火灾和飓风影像。Vantor（原 Maxar）提供 WorldView 条带，Planet 提供 PlanetScope、SkySat 和 Pelican 场景以及事件前的 Planet 季度镶嵌图。此行打开带有事件列表的“事件影像”窗口。影像许可为 CC BY-NC 4.0——仅限非商业用途。

column1: Images of extraordinary events from the open catalogs of Vantor and Planet.
column2: 来自 Vantor 和 Planet 开放目录的突发事件影像。

column1: Searching the lidar catalogs IGN LiDAR HD and USGS 3DEP near the point…
column2: 正在该点附近搜索 IGN LiDAR HD 和 USGS 3DEP 激光雷达目录…

column1: There are no lidar tiles of IGN LiDAR HD and USGS 3DEP near the point.
column2: 该点附近没有 IGN LiDAR HD 和 USGS 3DEP 激光雷达分块。

column1: Compare two days: left of the line on the globe - the images of an earlier day, right - of the chosen day. The line is dragged with the mouse.
column2: 比较两天：地球上分割线左侧是较早一天的影像，右侧是所选日期的影像。用鼠标拖动分割线。

column1: There is no event {key} in the catalogs.
Borders of countries and regions, rivers and lakes, labels on the globe.
column2: 国家和地区边界、河流和湖泊、地球上的标注。

column1: There are no heights in the square.
There are no peaks and pits with such a drop in the square.
column2: 方形区域内没有这样落差的山峰和洼地。
高度 {height} 米，高出 {drop} 米。
高度 {height} 米，深度 {drop} 米。

column1: Written to «My places»: peaks {peaks} and pits {pits}.
column2: 已写入“我的地点”：山峰 {peaks} 个，洼地 {pits} 个。

column1: Half the side of the computed square. Larger - a coarser grid step, it is about one six-hundredth of the side.
column2: 计算方形区域边长的一半。越大 - 网格步长越粗，约为边长的六百分之一。

column1: What the square shows on the globe - the steepness of a slope or the side of the world it faces. The rows «Slope» and «Aspect» of the section «Layers» go off meanwhile.
column2: 方形区域在地球上显示的内容 - 坡面的陡度或其朝向的方位。此时“图层”部分的“坡度”和“坡向”行会关闭。

column1: A peak is higher than everything around it within this radius, a pit is lower. Larger - only large peaks and pits remain.
column2: 山峰比此半径内周围的一切都高，洼地则更低。越大 - 只保留大的山峰和洼地。

column1: The least rise of a peak over the lowest point around it or depth of a pit under the highest one. Smaller - more small hills and hollows.
column2: 山峰高出周围最低点的最小高度，或洼地低于最高点的深度。越小 - 小丘和凹地越多。

column1: Slope and aspect of the square by the heights, a 3 × 3 kernel - a colouring on the globe and a summary by slope classes and sides of the world.
column2: 根据高程计算方形区域的坡度和坡向，3 × 3 核 - 地球上的着色以及按坡度等级和方位的汇总。

column1: Peaks and closed hollows of the square - points in «My places» with the height and the drop.
column2: 方形区域的山峰和封闭凹地 - “我的地点”中带高度和落差的点。

column1: Remove the colouring of the square from the globe.
column2: 从地球上移除方形区域的着色。

column1: Main watercourse {km} km, fall {fall} m, slope {slope} per mille.
column2: 主水道 {km} 公里，落差 {fall} 米，比降 {slope}‰。

column1: Mean slope of the hillsides {slope} per mille by SP 33-101-2003.
column2: 按 SP 33-101-2003 计算的坡面平均坡度 {slope}‰。

column1: Drainage density {dens} km per km², watercourses with a catchment from {area} km².
column2: 河网密度 {dens} 公里/平方公里，集水面积自 {area} 平方公里起的水道。

column1: There are no heights at the point.
Water from the point flows nowhere.

column2: 长度 {km} 公里，落差 {drop} 米。

column1: The placemark is beyond the edge of the height data.
column2: 地标位于高程数据边缘之外。

column1: Water from the placemark flows nowhere.

column2: 未包含的最短线 {count} 条。

column1: Water does not flow to the point: there is no catchment.
column2: 没有水流向该点，没有集水区。

column1: The outlet is moved to the channel {m} m from the point.
column2: 出口断面已移到距该点 {m} 米的河槽上。

column1: The catchment reaches the edge of the area, its part beyond the edge is not counted. A larger radius is needed.
column2: 集水区到达区域边缘，边缘以外的部分未计入。需要更大的半径。

column1: There are no watercourses with such a catchment at the edge of the square.
column2: 方形区域边缘没有这样集水面积的水道。

column1: Basins written to «My places»: {count}, they cover {area} km² of the square.
column2: 已写入“我的地点”的流域：{count} 个，覆盖方形区域的 {area} 平方公里。

column1: There are no watercourses with such a catchment and order in the square.
column2: 方形区域内没有这样集水面积和级别的水道。
级别 {order}，集水面积 {area} 平方公里。

column1: Watercourses written to «My places»: {count}, the largest order {order}.
column2: 已写入“我的地点”的水道：{count} 条，最高级别 {order}。

column1: Water does not flow to the placemark: there is no catchment.
column2: 没有水流向地标，没有集水区。

column1: Flooded {area} km², water volume {volume} million m³, the largest depth {depth} m.
column2: 淹没 {area} 平方公里，水量 {volume} 百万立方米，最大深度 {depth} 米。

column1: The water reached the edge of the area and can go further. A larger radius is needed.
column2: 水已到达区域边缘，还可能继续蔓延。需要更大的半径。

column1: The level is not above the point, there is no water.
column2: 水位不高于该点，没有水。

column1: Height of the water surface above the sea level. The water floods everything below the level that it reaches from the point. Hollows beyond a higher ridge stay dry.
column2: 水面高于海平面的高度。水淹没从该点能到达的、低于水位的一切。更高山脊后面的凹地保持干燥。

column1: Rise of the water above the point height, up to {rise} m.
column2: 水面高出该点高度的值，最多 {rise} 米。

column1: The outline of the flooding - a polygon in «My places» with the level, area and volume.
column2: 淹没范围轮廓 - “我的地点”中带水位、面积和水量的多边形。

column1: Remove the water from the globe.
Level {level} m, flooded {area} km², water volume {volume} million m³, the largest depth {depth} m.
column2: 水位 {level} 米，淹没 {area} 平方公里，水量 {volume} 百万立方米，最大深度 {depth} 米。

column1: Half the side of the computed square. The flow line ends at its edge, a catchment larger than the square is not counted fully. The grid step is about one six-hundredth of the side.
column2: 计算方形区域边长的一半。径流线在其边缘结束，大于方形区域的集水区不会完整计入。网格步长约为边长的六百分之一。

column1: The river network - watercourses with a catchment of at least this area. Smaller - a denser network with brooks and ravines.
column2: 河网 - 集水面积不小于此值的水道。越小 - 河网越密，包括小溪和冲沟。

column1: The least Strahler order of a watercourse in the river network. A source is order 1, after two watercourses of one order merge - one more. Larger - only large rivers, the orders are counted over the whole network.
column2: 河网中水道的最小 Strahler 级别。源头为 1 级，两条同级水道汇合后 - 加一级。越大 - 只有大河，级别在整个河网上计算。

column1: Within this radius from the point the channel is searched - the place with the largest catchment, the catchment is built from it. A click near a river so gives the catchment of the river. 0 - the catchment exactly from the point.
column2: 在该点周围此半径内搜索河槽 - 集水面积最大的位置，集水区从那里构建。因此在河流附近点击会得到该河流的集水区。0 - 集水区严格从该点构建。

column1: The flow line ends on reaching a watercourse with a catchment from the area of the field «Watercourses from». Without the check the line goes to the edge of the square.
column2: 径流线到达集水面积不小于“水道集水面积自”字段值的水道时结束。不勾选时，线一直延伸到方形区域边缘。

column1: The flow line ends where the mean slope over the section length is below the threshold - at the foot of a slope, on a terrace, on a flood plain. A short shelf on a steep slope does not stop the line.
column2: 径流线在区段长度上的平均坡度低于阈值处结束 - 在坡脚、阶地、河漫滩上。陡坡上的短平台不会使线停止。

column1: The slope below which the terrain is counted as flattened.
column2: 低于此坡度的地形视为变缓。

column1: The length of the section over which the mean slope is measured. Larger - only a long flattening stops the line.
column2: 测量平均坡度的区段长度。越大 - 只有较长的变缓才使线停止。

column1: Lines from the placemark end flowing into a line built earlier, and the common channel goes as one line. Without the check each line goes to the end.
column2: 来自地标的线在汇入先前构建的线时结束，共同河槽作为一条线延续。不勾选时，每条线都延伸到终点。

column1: The path of the water from the point down the terrain - a line in «My places». Hollows are filled up to the overflow, so the line passes through lakes and closed basins. For a path or polygon - lines from all its nodes, in a folder.
column2: 水从该点沿地形向下的路径 - “我的地点”中的一条线。凹地填充到溢出为止，因此线会穿过湖泊和封闭盆地。对于路径或多边形 - 从其所有节点出发的线，放在一个文件夹中。

column1: The area from which the water flows to the point and the main watercourse - a folder in «My places» with the area, slopes and the watercourse length. The catchment is built from the channel near the point.
column2: 水流向该点的区域和主水道 - “我的地点”中的文件夹，包含面积、坡度和水道长度。集水区从该点附近的河槽构建。

column1: Watercourses of the square with the Strahler order - lines in «My places», the line width grows with the order.
column2: 方形区域内带 Strahler 级别的水道 - “我的地点”中的线，线宽随级别增加。

column1: The square divided into basins of outlets - places where watercourses with a catchment from the area of the field «Watercourses from» leave the square. Polygons in «My places».
column2: 方形区域划分为各出口断面的流域 - 集水面积不小于“水道集水面积自”字段值的水道离开方形区域的位置。“我的地点”中的多边形。

column1: The sea level above the present one. The water floods everything below the level, below zero it opens the shelf. About -120 m - the last glacial maximum, about +70 m - the melting of all glaciers.
column2: 相对于当前海平面的高度。水淹没低于该水位的一切，低于零时露出大陆架。约 -120 米 - 末次冰盛期，约 +70 米 - 所有冰川融化。

column1: The water floods everything below the level over the whole globe. The connection with the sea is not checked, so lowlands inside continents are flooded too. The water is seen with the terrain on.
column2: 水淹没整个地球上低于该水位的一切。不检查与海洋的连通，因此大陆内部的低地也会被淹没。开启地形时可见水面。

column1: Slope and aspect of a square around the point by the heights, a summary, peaks and pits.
column2: 根据高程计算该点周围方形区域的坡度和坡向、汇总、山峰和洼地。

column1: What is seen from the point in a circle of the given radius.
column2: 在给定半径的圆内从该点能看到什么。

column1: Hours of direct sun per day around the point.
column2: 该点周围每天的直射阳光小时数。

column1: Water from the point up to the given level, area, volume and depths.
column2: 从该点到给定水位的水、面积、水量和深度。

column1: Flow line, catchment and river network around the point.
column2: 该点周围的径流线、集水区和河网。

column1: Raising and lowering the sea level over the whole globe.
column2: 在整个地球上升高和降低海平面。

column1: No tracks. A track is a point layer of a GeoPackage file with a date and time field. Open such a file, and the layer becomes a track.
column2: 没有轨迹。轨迹是 GeoPackage 文件中带有日期时间字段的点图层。打开这样的文件后，该图层即成为轨迹。

column1: A glTF, Collada or OBJ model file. The model drives along the path of each object, its front looks along the motion.
column2: glTF、Collada 或 OBJ 模型文件。模型沿每个对象的路径行驶，前部朝向运动方向。

column1: The layer is no longer shown as a track.
column2: 该图层不再显示为轨迹。

column1: The field with the date and time of the point. Date and time fields, ISO 8601 text and a number of seconds since 1970 fit.
column2: 包含点的日期和时间的字段。可用日期时间字段、ISO 8601 文本以及自 1970 年起的秒数。

column1: The field that tells the objects apart, for example the vehicle number. Each object has its own path and label.
column2: 用于区分对象的字段，例如车辆编号。每个对象有自己的路径和标签。

column1: The colour of the travelled path.
A numeric field with the height of the point. On the ground - the object and the model stand on the terrain.
column2: 包含点高度的数值字段。贴地 - 对象和模型立于地形之上。

column1: The size factor of the model. With the factor 1 the model stands in its own metres.
column2: 模型的尺寸系数。系数为 1 时模型按其自身的米制尺寸显示。

column1: Clockwise turn of the model to the motion. Needed when the front of the model in the file does not look north.
